channel.title: GTA VI News | GTA VI Guide
channel.description: GTA VI announcements in chronological order. An independent fan site.

item.title: Digital preload brought forward to November 10
item.description: Originally announced in June for November 12, preload was moved to midnight local time on November 10 in Rockstar's early November announcement. The PS5 version is reported to be around 212 GB.

item.title: Preorders open, with two editions announced
item.description: Standard Edition ($79.99) is available digitally or as a code in a box, while Ultimate Edition ($99.99) is digital only. Purchases made before November 20 include the "Vintage Vice City Pack" bonus.

item.title: Release date moved to November 19, 2026
item.description: Rockstar moved the release to November 19, 2026, saying it needed more time to polish the game.

item.title: Second trailer released
item.description: The second trailer offered a closer look at Lucia, Jason and the state of Leonida.

item.title: Launch delayed to May 26, 2026
item.description: The release, previously planned for fall 2025, was moved to May 26, 2026.

item.title: First trailer released
item.description: The first trailer officially introduced the game and confirmed the return to Vice City.
